templates.name: Build Health Check
templates.prompt: Run the PRISM build: cd C:/PRISM/mcp-server && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -5. Report: PASS if 0 errors, FAIL with error count and first 3 errors. Save result to ~/.prism/telemetry/cron-results.jsonl as JSON line with {timestamp, cron: build-health, status: pass|fail, details: ...}.

templates.name: Test Regression Sweep
templates.prompt: Run PRISM test suite: cd C:/PRISM/mcp-server && npx vitest run --reporter=json 2>/dev/null | tail -20. Extract: total tests, passed, failed, skipped. Compare against last run in ~/.prism/telemetry/cron-results.jsonl. Report any NEW failures (tests that passed last time but fail now). Save result as JSON line.

templates.name: Dispatcher-Engine Sync Check
templates.prompt: Verify dispatcher wiring: count case statements in C:/PRISM/mcp-server/src/tools/dispatchers/calcDispatcher.ts and compare against last known count. Check if any new engine files exist in src/engines/ without corresponding dispatcher actions. Report mismatches. Save to cron-results.jsonl.

templates.name: Schema Drift Detection
templates.prompt: Check for schema drift: compare z.enum values in dispatcher files against actual action handler case statements. Flag any z.enum entries without handlers, and any handlers without z.enum entries. Save findings to cron-results.jsonl.

templates.name: Memory Pruning
templates.prompt: Read C:/Users/Admin.DIGITALSTORM-PC/.claude/projects/C--Windows-System32/memory/MEMORY.md. Count lines. If >180, identify entries referencing files that no longer exist (spot-check 5 random file paths). Recommend entries to archive. Save report to cron-results.jsonl.

templates.name: Catalog Freshness Audit
templates.prompt: Check modification dates of key catalog files: machine-profiles-catalog.ts, material data files, tool catalogs in C:/PRISM/mcp-server/src/data/. Flag any not modified in 30+ days. Count total entries per catalog. Save to cron-results.jsonl.

templates.name: Dead Code Detection
templates.prompt: Search for potentially dead code in C:/PRISM/mcp-server/src/engines/: find engine files not exported from index.ts, not imported by any dispatcher, and not referenced in tests. List top 10 candidates. Save to cron-results.jsonl.

templates.name: Dependency Vulnerability Scan
templates.prompt: Run: cd C:/PRISM/mcp-server && npm audit --json 2>/dev/null | head -50. Parse results for critical and high severity vulnerabilities. If any found, create a summary. Save to cron-results.jsonl.

templates.name: Documentation Coverage
templates.prompt: Sample 10 random engine files from C:/PRISM/mcp-server/src/engines/. Check if each has JSDoc on exported functions. Calculate coverage percentage. Compare against last run. Save to cron-results.jsonl.

templates.name: Hook Efficiency Analysis
templates.prompt: Read ~/.prism/telemetry/ JSONL files. Count: tool failures, stop failures, agent spawns, compactions per week. Calculate ratios: failures/total, agents/session. Flag anomalies (>2x previous week). Save analysis to cron-results.jsonl.

templates.name: Automation ROI Report
templates.prompt: Generate monthly automation report: Count hook fires from telemetry, estimate tokens saved by dedup/redirect hooks, count auto-fixed issues vs manual warnings, calculate cron job success rates. Produce summary with estimated token savings. Save to cron-results.jsonl.

templates.name: Wiki Harvest (H: drive memories + tribal + engines)
templates.prompt: Run the wiki harvester: cd H:/prism-knowledge-wiki && node mcp-server/scripts/wiki-harvest-h-drive.mjs 2>&1 | tail -20. The harvester is idempotent (sha1 manifest at knowledge/wiki/.harvest-manifest.json — unchanged sources are skipped). Token-economy floor: Ollama must own >=80% of summary/cross-ref work; if Ollama is unreachable AND the run would log >=1 contradiction, the script aborts. Report: harvested-new count, skipped-unchanged count, ollamaTokens vs claudeTokens ratio, any contradictions written to knowledge/wiki/.contradictions.jsonl. Save to cron-results.jsonl as JSON line {timestamp, cron: wiki-harvest-h-drive, status: pass|fail, details: ...}.
